prompt: Build Angular 21 UserProfileComponent with httpResource, Zod validation, and HttpTestingController tests

assertions.name: httpresource-with-parse
assertions.description: Uses httpResource() with parse option set to Zod schema.parse

assertions.name: has-value-guard
assertions.description: Guards .value() reads with .hasValue() in template to prevent runtime throw in error state

assertions.name: error-signal-usage
assertions.description: Uses .error() signal for error state display, not try/catch

assertions.name: signal-input-reactive
assertions.description: userId is a signal input (input() or input.required()) driving reactive re-fetch

assertions.name: testbed-tick-pattern
assertions.description: Tests use TestBed.tick() to trigger the httpResource effect

assertions.name: when-stable-pattern
assertions.description: Tests use ApplicationRef.whenStable() (or equivalent) to await value propagation

assertions.name: zod-schema-definition
assertions.description: Defines a proper Zod schema with z.object(), z.string(), z.enum(), z.string().email()
